dct_title_s: Kontur Population: Global Population Density for 22km H3 Hexagons
dct_description_sm: Global Population dataset. Vector H3 hexagons with population counts at 22km resolution. * 400m resolution version: [data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset) * 3km resolution version: [data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset-3km](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kontur-population-dataset-3km) * Per-country subsets of Kontur Population: [data.humdata.org/organization/kontur](https://data.humdata.org/organization/kontur) Fixed up fusion of GHSL, Facebook, Microsoft Buildings, Copernicus Global Land Service Land Cover, Land Information New Zealand, and OpenStreetMap data.
